apps.subtitle: 轻量、纯净的第三方知乎客户端
apps.localizedDescription: 基于 React Native (Expo) 构建的轻量级第三方知乎客户端，无广告，支持多账号切换、游客模式、全局主题色自定义与深色模式，可查看热榜、推荐、回答、文章、想法与评论区，并支持从 GitHub Releases 自动更新。

versions.localizedDescription:
更多的复用缓存与小功能补充。

* 优化原生正文首载并复用问题列表回答数据 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/122
* perf: reuse cached avatars and images across page mounts by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/123
- feat: render content endorsements and retain list labels
- feat: show stable relationship hints above detail content
- feat: show member columns on profile

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/compare/v0.8.0...v0.8.1
